ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Medicaid Program
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and those involved.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and waste in Minnesota's Medicaid program. By following the money and investigating those involved, we can shed light on a critical issue affecting the state's most vulnerable citizens.
